title: 中華麥塊模組包 ChunghwaMC modpack (chmc)
description: 用來在中華麥塊伺服器使用的模組包 與伺服器上安裝的模組配對 A modpack designed to match the mods installed on the ChunghwaMC server
body:
用來在中華麥塊伺服器使用的模組包

支援對各式玩家來說效果顯著的模組
如：
生存：Jade, Map, 等更多
生電：Carpet, MiniHUD, 等更多
建築：Axiom, WorldEdit, 等更多

你可以在此包基礎上修改成你自己需要的包而無須告知我們

A modpack designed to match the mods installed on the ChunghwaMC server

Includes mods that provide significant benefits for different types of players, such as:

Survival: Jade, Map, and more

Technical: Carpet, MiniHUD, and more

Building: Axiom, WorldEdit, and more

You are free to modify this pack to suit your own needs without notifying us.
